newsitem.title: UK: Schroders slips on cost rises, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Schroders slips on cost rises, outlook.

text.p: Shares in investment bank Schroders Plc were lower on Wednesday due to rising cost worries and a cautious outlook from the company which accompanied annual results at the top of analysts expectations.

The shares were 20p lower at 17.17-1/2 stg by 0905 GMT. Schroders reported annual profits of 238.7 million stg compared with 197.3 million stg a year ago. Analysts had forecast profits of between 230-240 million stg. A total dividend of 20p per share topped expectations of 18.5-19p.
But the company warned that it would be hard to repeat this performance in the current year and traders said a closer study of the company's results had also led to a markdown in the shares.

"At first glance the results look quite flattering, but once you look at the breakdown the costs are some 20 percent higher and contribution from the merchant bank side was slightly below expectations."
